title: OraclePrice
description: A posted fiat price: units of the quote currency per 1 EUTC. For EURC this is always 1 (both are euro-denominated); for USDC it is the EUR/USD market rate (USD per EUR).

CollateralType.description: Collateral types accepted for EUTC minting (spec: EURC primary at 1:1, USDC with a 0.5% premium).

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)
